versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

insurance-clause-talking v0.1.2

- Clarified workflow for collecting insurance clauses, stills, and required rights before creating talking clips.
- Documented explicit requirements for inspecting stills, including technical image details and handling of authorized uploads.
- Codified a three-stage, card-based paid process—voice clone, speech synthesis, video animation—each with clear confirmation and stopping points.
- Expanded detailed instructions on pricing, credit handling, and necessary API calls; added explicit top-up protocol for insufficient balance.
- Emphasized that each clip explains only supplied clause text—never invents or promises coverage, benefit limits, or payout details.
- Added routing guidelines for similar requests to ensure proper skill usage and workflow.
